newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Mother, daughter gunned down in Colombia graveyard.
newsitem.headline: Mother, daughter gunned down in Colombia graveyard.

text.p: A mother and daughter were buried on Sunday in the same graveyard where they had been gunned down the day before by an unidentified assassin in western Colombia, national media said.

Judith Castaneda had been visiting her husband's grave, with her daughter Luz Maria, in the town of Armenia, in Quindio province, when a man opened fire, killing them both. The killer then escaped on a motorcycle, police sources said,
The two women were landowners and money-lenders, according to the Caracol radio network.
